text:
A simple illustration of a dynamic digital image of a scene between a woman and two different men, standing among tropical plants.
In the center of the picture, a beautiful young woman with long red hair stands with her whole body turned towards the camera, dressed in a seamless tight high-necked long-sleeve max dress, silver in color and decorated with purple inserts. She is 40 years old. She has a slender build, fair skin and an aristocratic face of dangerous beauty with a sly smile. 
On the right, the picture shows a young man with short dark hair arranged in an elegant hairstyle, wearing a silver loose attire with purple inserts and silver trousers. He stands a little behind the woman, pressing his chest against the woman's back and putting his hand on her shoulder, he looks directly into the camera. He is 50 years old. He has a slender build, fair skin and an elongated aristocratic face of dangerous beauty with a deep-set black eyes and sly smile.
On the left, the picture shows a blond-haired young man with a fashionable short hairstyle, dressed a silver loose attire with purple inserts and silver trousers. He stands behind the woman. He is 50 years old. He has an elongated aristocratic face of dangerous beauty with a sly smile with a well-defined chin, deep-set steel-colored eyes and a mouth slightly open in a sad smile.
Background: A romantic atmosphere prevails, thanks to the soft lighting and details. Shiny bright green tropical plants with lots of small pink and purple flowers grow all around., and metal walls with instruments and portholes of the underwater station of the future are visible in the background. The semi-darkness of the underwater world reigns behind the portholes of the station.
The atmosphere is romantic, light, cyberpunk, with extensive scenic concept art and rich textures. Futuristic style, high-quality detail, professional shooting, depth of field, detailed natural skin texture.
